name: automation-workflow-guard
description: Static CI checks for n8n workflows, OpenAPI action schemas, tracked env files, and exposed automation secrets.

scripts.check: node --check src/guard.js && node --check src/index.js && node --check bin/guard.js && node --check vscode/extension.cjs && node --check vscode/scan-document.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-vscode.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm test && npm run prepare:vscode
